Adult Participant: This equals 1 if the participant is >17
High Risk: This equals 1 if the participant has a GIRA report that contains high risk information
Monogenic High: This equals 1 if the participant has a GIRA report with any high monogenic result (without being overwritten) (n/a for peds)
Override: This equals 1 if APOB, EPCAM, LDLRAP1, or LMNA has an override selected (n/a for peds)
High PRS: This equals 1 if the participant has a GIRA report with any high PRS results (excludes Breast Cancer)
BC Integrated Score: This equals 1 if the participant has a GIRA report with a high BOADICEA score (n/a for peds or males)
Family Health Hx: This equals 1 if the participant has a GIRA report with high FHx for Afib, CKD, CHD, or prostate cancer from metree or rescue survey results (excludes pediatrics)

PCE: This equals 2 if the participant has a GIRA report with a PCE score >7.5 (only shown for high risk CHD). This equals 1 if the participant has a GIRA report with a PCE score < 7.5 (only shown for high risk CHD). This shows 0 if no score is calculated or no score is shown to the participant because they were not high risk for CHD
Metrics (Previous)
Metric 2 (Family Health Hx) this should show a 1 if Afib, CKD, CHD, or prostate cancer Family Health Hx results are high risk and nothing else is.
Metric 3 (Has High Risk) this should show a 1 if any of the conditions are high risk.
Metric 4: This will show a 1 if any PRS results are high
Metric 6: This will show a 1 if any PRS result is high and no other result is high.
Metric 7: Flags all PCE + PRS (Integrated Score) present (present = '1', >= 7.5 = '2')
